name: Bisection Method for Surface Depth Refinement
definition: An iterative root-finding algorithm that halves the search interval at each step. It is called as an alternative to the Secant method in the ray marching pipeline.
summary: The Bisection Method for Surface Depth Refinement is an iterative root-finding algorithm that guarantees convergence for continuous functions by systematically halving the search interval, unlike linear interpolation techniques.
